description: Sydney Basin bioregion power stations is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bioregional Assessment Program. You can find a link to the parent dataset in the Lineage Field in this metadata statement. The History Field in this metadata statement describes how this dataset was derived. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bioregional Assessment Program. Its tags are Hunter subregion, New South Wales, Sydney Basin bioregion, environment, imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2022-04-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
